Long-term vision is to reach revenue of ₹475–500 Cr by FY31.
Current order book stands at ₹68–70 Cr (78% export, 22% domestic).
Finished propeller-shaft assemblies command 5% to 10% higher margins than component sales.
Targeting full ramp-up by Q4FY28, supporting peak annual revenue of ₹250 Cr post expansion.
Added 13 new customers in Q2FY27 and entered defense and industrial shaft segments.
Q2FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 28.0% compared to 30.9% in Q1FY27.
